name: notebooklm-ingest
description: Pull the user's chosen NotebookLM notes into their personal knowledge wiki. Runs the notebooklm-py CLI inside the user's own openclaw container, normalises each note's text and then hashes it, and pushes it to javis-server over one gateway-token-authenticated endpoint; javis-server's existing poller distils it into wiki pages. Eight script commands do all the I/O (notebooks / notes / fetch / push / report / history / schedule / doctor); --dry-run reports the pages it would write and writes nothing. NOTEBOOKLM_TRANSPORT is pinned to the library default and the impersonating transport is refused. The push endpoint is write-only: nothing here can read the wiki, another source, or another user's data. Triggers: 'fetch my notebooklm', 'ingest my notebooklm', 'notebooklm to wiki', '同步我的 notebooklm'.
